tips.title: Tips for someone's Santa
tips.intro: Know what someone would love? Leave a tip for their Santa. Only their Santa reads it: never the person it's about, never the organizer, and you won't find out who their Santa is.
tips.text-placeholder: e.g. collects Moomin mugs, wears size M
tips.anonymous-hint: Their Santa won't see your name.
tips.added: Tip saved. Only {name}'s Santa will see it.
tips.closed: Tips are closed for this Secret Santa.
tips.nobody: Nobody to leave a tip about yet.
tips.dialog-description: Only their Santa reads it: never the person it's about, never the organizer.

boards.intro: Everyone has a board where the others plan one gift for them, together. Nobody ever sees their own board.
boards.empty: Nothing here yet. Start the plan!
boards.text-placeholder: e.g. I found the camera they want, shall we?
boards.anonymous-hint: The others won't see your name.

ask.title: Ask {name} a question
ask.sent: Question on its way. {name} gets it shortly.

psst.title: Psst!
psst.emptyWishlist: {name}'s wishlist is empty. Send a Psst! and they'll hear their Santa would love some ideas.
psst.moreDetails: Send a Psst! and {name} will hear their Santa would love more detail on their wishes.
psst.sent: Psst! sent. {name} hears about it shortly, without your name.
psst.next: You can send another Psst! from {date}.

for-you.psst-emptyWishlist: Your Santa would love some ideas. Add a few wishes to your wishlist.
for-you.psst-emptyWishlist-for: {name}'s Santa would love some ideas. Add a few wishes to {name}'s wishlist.
for-you.psst-moreDetails: Your Santa would love a bit more detail on your wishes: sizes, colours, links.
for-you.psst-moreDetails-for: {name}'s Santa would love a bit more detail on {name}'s wishes.
for-you.questions-intro: Your Santa sees your answer. You'll never know who asked.

errors.invalid: Check the text and try again.
errors.rate-limited: That's the limit for now. Try again later.
errors.closed: This Secret Santa is closed for that.
errors.gone: This is no longer available. Refresh the page.
errors.wrong-kind: Their wishlist just changed. Refresh and try again.
